sections.heading: Why Panic Bar Repairs Should Never Wait
sections.body: Panic bars, also called push bars or exit devices, are critical components of any commercial door system. They allow rapid egress in emergencies and are standard hardware on high-traffic commercial entry and exit points throughout the Tysons area. When a panic bar becomes stiff, unlatched, misaligned, or completely inoperative, it puts occupants at risk and disrupts normal building operations. A malfunctioning exit device can also lead to doors that won't close or latch properly, creating security vulnerabilities around the clock. Property managers overseeing office parks near the Greensboro Metro station or retail spaces along Route 7 know that deferred hardware maintenance almost always leads to more expensive repairs down the road. Our team responds promptly to service calls throughout Tysons so you can address problems before they escalate. We diagnose the issue on-site, explain your options clearly, and complete repairs efficiently to minimize disruption to your tenants or customers.

sections.heading: Common Panic Bar Problems We Repair
sections.body: Our technicians are experienced with a wide range of push bar and exit device issues that affect commercial glass doors and aluminum storefront systems. Some of the most frequent problems we encounter in Tysons commercial properties include panic bars that have become loose or pull away from the door, internal mechanisms that are jammed or broken, misaligned strike plates that prevent the latch from seating correctly, and damaged or worn push pads that no longer depress smoothly. We also address issues with vertical rod devices, which add complexity but are common on double-door assemblies in retail and office buildings. Weather exposure and heavy daily use both contribute to wear over time, and properties with high foot traffic near Tysons Galleria or large mixed-use developments tend to see hardware wear sooner than lower-traffic locations. Regardless of the specific failure point, we carry common replacement parts and components to handle most repairs in a single visit.

sections.heading: Panic Bar Repair for Glass Doors and Aluminum Storefronts
sections.body: Many commercial properties in Tysons feature glass doors with aluminum frames, which require careful handling during any hardware repair or replacement. Panic bars on glass doors must be installed and adjusted with precision to avoid stressing the glass or compromising the door's alignment. Our team has extensive experience working with these systems and understands how hardware, frame, and glass interact as a complete assembly. When a panic bar on a glass door is improperly repaired, it can lead to cracked glass, damaged seals, or door closure problems that require far more extensive work later. We take care to protect the glass surface during all work and verify that the door operates correctly from both sides after every repair. For property managers and general contractors overseeing commercial builds or tenant fit-outs in the Tysons area, we are available for both scheduled maintenance visits and urgent repair calls.
